outcome: maternal outcomes (e.g., hysterectomy, bladder repair, maternal mortality)
cohort: 18 females with a clinical diagnosis of morbidly adherent placenta, carrying singleton fetuses of more than 26 weeks gestational age, were included in the study.
finding: Previous caesarean scar and placenta previa are identified as major risk factors for morbidly adherent placenta, and timely surgical intervention can prevent long-term complications.
